categories.title: Body Scrubs
intro: Reveal radiant, silky-smooth skin with Glamour Day Spa’s rejuvenating Body Scrub services. Our luxurious exfoliation treatments gently buff away dead skin cells, unclog pores, and improve circulation—leaving your skin glowing, refreshed, and irresistibly soft. Using high-quality, nourishing ingredients, our expert therapists customize each scrub to suit your skin type and preferences. Whether you're prepping for a special occasion or simply indulging in self-care, our body scrubs provide the perfect blend of relaxation and revitalization. Treat your skin to the glow it deserves at Glamour Day Spa.

services.name: Lavender Sugar Body Scrub
services.description: This treatment exfoliate your body with a blend of micro buffing beads and micronized bluff and micronized apricot seed powder. Gently polish away dead surface cells and skin-dulling debris to reveal smoother, softer skin beneath. This full body exfoliation of dead skin cells will increase circulation and improve skin tone. Leaves skin feeling silky-smooth.

services.name: Back Polish
services.description: A refreshing treatment that deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and smooths the skin on your back. This polish removes impurities and dead skin cells while restoring softness and radiance — leaving your skin silky, hydrated, and glowing.

services.name: Lavender Sugar Body Scrub with Seaweed mask
services.description: Submerge yourself in the world of Deep Sea Therapy and feel the divine power of its healing energy. Seaweed, which has a high mineral content, is applied all over the body to help boost metabolism. The body is wrapped for twenty minutes to intensify the mud's detoxifying and nourishing properties.

categories.title: Massages
intro: Unwind, recharge, and restore harmony with our diverse selection of massage therapies at Glamour Day Spa. Whether you’re looking for deep relaxation, stress relief, or targeted muscle recovery, our expert therapists customize each session to your needs. From calming Swedish massages and therapeutic deep tissue work to the soothing warmth of hot stone treatments, every experience is designed to ease tension and refresh your spirit. Step into our tranquil atmosphere and let our skilled team help you feel renewed, relaxed, and restored.

services.name: Anti-Stress Massage
services.description: A balanced massage that blends Swedish and Deep Tissue techniques to deliver both deep relaxation and effective pain relief, leaving your body restored, relaxed, and renewed.

services.name: Deep Tissue Massage
services.description: Deep tissue massage is designed for those who need more than light relaxation—it targets chronic tension and tight, overworked muscles. Using slower, more focused pressure than a Swedish massage, your therapist works into the deeper layers of muscle, tendons, and fascia to break up knots, ease stiffness, and restore mobility. This treatment is ideal if you experience persistent soreness, carry stress in specific areas, or simply prefer a firmer touch.

services.name: Hot Stone Massage
services.description: A hot stone massage uses warm, smooth stones to gently melt away tension and relax tight muscles. The comforting heat helps improve circulation, softens stiff areas, and allows your therapist to work more deeply without added pressure. This deeply soothing treatment promotes total relaxation, eases stress, and leaves your body feeling calm, restored, and rejuvenated.

services.name: Prenatal Massage
services.description: A prenatal massage is a calming, therapeutic treatment designed to ease common pregnancy discomforts, improve circulation, and promote relaxation for both mom and baby. With the support of extra pillows and gentle positioning, this service ensures complete comfort and safety throughout the 2nd and 3rd trimesters, helping you feel relaxed, supported, and refreshed.

services.name: Lymphatic Drainage Massage with Wood Therapy
services.description: Wood therapy uses specially designed wooden tools to help relax tight muscles, break down stubborn fat and cellulite, tone and sculpt the body, and stimulate healthy circulation. This technique supports a smoother appearance while leaving you feeling refreshed and revitalized.

services.name: Breast Enhancing Treatment
services.description: A natural, non-surgical treatment that enhances the size, shape, and firmness of the breasts. This service combines gentle massage, collagen stimulation, and a nourishing hydrating mask to boost circulation, support healthy tissue growth, and leave the skin smooth, lifted, and beautifully toned.

services.name: Swedish Massage
services.description: A Swedish massage uses smooth, flowing strokes and soothing oils to gently release muscle tension, improve circulation, and promote deep, full-body relaxation. This classic technique increases oxygen flow, helps flush out toxins, and reduces both physical and emotional stress—making it the perfect therapeutic escape for restoring balance to body and mind.

services.name: Aromatherapy Massage
services.description: Aromatherapy massage combines the soothing techniques of a Swedish massage with the therapeutic benefits of essential oils. Using a blend of highly concentrated plant oils infused into the massage lotion or oil, this treatment allows you to inhale calming aromas while your skin absorbs their natural properties. The result is a deeply relaxing experience that nurtures both body and mind, enhancing mood, easing tension, and promoting overall well-being.

services.name: Reflexology Massage
services.description: Reflexology uses gentle, targeted pressure on specific points of the feet, hands, or ears to encourage deep relaxation, improve circulation, reduce stress, and support the body’s natural balance. This soothing therapy helps release tension throughout the entire body, promoting overall wellness and a renewed sense of calm.

services.name: Lymphatic Drainage Massage
services.description: A gentle, rhythmic massage that activates the lymphatic system to help flush out toxins, reduce swelling, and improve circulation. This light, soothing technique supports your body’s natural detox process, leaving you feeling lighter, rejuvenated, and refreshed.

services.name: Meridian Massage
services.description: Meridian Health therapy stimulates the body’s energy channels to help clear toxins, balance the flow of qi and blood, relieve symptoms, and support overall wellness. This holistic approach promotes harmony within the body and helps prevent future imbalance or illness.

services.name: Abdominal Massage
services.description: A soothing treatment using special herbal oils to relax the abdominal muscles, ease discomfort, and support healthy digestion. This gentle therapy helps relieve issues such as bloating and constipation, promoting a calmer, more balanced digestive system.

categories.title: Eyelash Extensions
intro: Enhance your natural beauty with our luxurious eyelash services at Glamour Day Spa. Whether you're looking for a subtle lift or dramatic volume, our expert technicians offer personalized eyelash extensions tailored to your preferences. Using premium, lightweight lashes, we create a fuller, longer lash line that enhances your eyes and adds effortless elegance. We also provide eyelash tinting for a more defined look without the need for mascara. Our gentle application process ensures comfort and safety, leaving you with stunning lashes that last. Let us help you achieve a mesmerizing gaze and effortless glamour every day.

services.name: Classic Full Set
services.description: A classic full set applies one extension to each of your natural lashes, giving you a natural yet beautifully enhanced look with added length and curl. This style is perfect if you already have a healthy amount of natural lashes and want a result that resembles a fresh coat of mascara—just longer, fuller, and effortlessly polished.

services.name: Glamour Full Set
services.description: A Glamour Full Set delivers a bold, dramatic lash look with maximum fullness and intensity. Using dense, carefully crafted volume fans, this style creates a striking, glamorous effect that stands out while still maintaining a soft, lightweight feel. Perfect for clients who love a statement lash—ideal for special events, photos, or anyone who wants everyday luxury and eye-catching volume. (180 total)

services.name: Eyelash Tinting
services.description: Eyelash tinting is a quick, painless treatment that darkens your natural lashes from root to tip. Using a safe, gentle dye, this service enhances the depth and definition of your lashes—making them look fuller and more noticeable without mascara. It’s perfect for clients with lighter lashes or anyone who wants a low-maintenance, smudge-free boost to their everyday look.

services.name: Eyebrow Tinting
services.description: Eyebrow tinting is a quick and gentle treatment that adds color and definition to your natural brows. Using a safe, semi-permanent dye, this service enhances the shape, fills in lighter areas, and creates a more polished, fuller appearance. It’s perfect for clients looking to achieve beautifully defined brows without daily makeup.

services.name: Natural Full Set
services.description: A natural full set enhances your lashes with a soft, subtle boost that mimics your own lashes—just longer, neater, and slightly fuller. Extensions are applied in a way that maintains a lightweight, effortless look, perfect for clients who want noticeable definition without appearing overly dramatic. (140 total)

services.name: Hybrid 3D / 5D Full Set
services.description: A Hybrid 3D/5D full set blends classic individual extensions with 3D–5D volume fans to create a beautifully textured, fuller look. This style offers the perfect balance between natural and dramatic, adding both definition and soft volume.

services.name: Eyelash Lifting
services.description: Eyelash lifting is a semi-permanent treatment that gently curls and lifts your natural lashes from the base, giving them a longer, more open and lifted appearance. This service enhances your eyes without extensions or mascara, offering a soft, natural curl that lasts for weeks. It’s perfect for clients who want effortless, low-maintenance lashes with beautiful definition every day.

services.name: Eyelash Removal
services.description: Eyelash removal is a safe and gentle process used to dissolve and remove existing lash extensions without damaging your natural lashes. A professional-grade remover is applied to break down the adhesive, allowing the extensions to slide off comfortably. This service is ideal if your lashes need a fresh start, you’re experiencing outgrown extensions, or you simply want to return to your natural lash look.

categories.title: Head Spa
intro: Revitalize your scalp and restore balance with Glamour Day Spa’s luxurious Head Scalp services. Designed to promote healthy hair growth and relieve tension, our treatments deeply cleanse, exfoliate, and nourish the scalp using premium products and soothing techniques. Whether you're experiencing dryness, buildup, or simply want to indulge in a relaxing experience, our expert therapists tailor each session to your unique needs. Enjoy improved scalp circulation, reduced stress, and a refreshed, invigorated feeling from root to tip. Treat yourself to the ultimate self-care ritual—because healthy hair starts with a healthy scalp.

services.name: Head Scalp Massage
services.description: The Head Scalp Massage is a calming, therapeutic treatment designed to melt away stress and revitalized the senses. Peppermint oil is gently massaged into the scalp to relax the mind and stimulate circulation, while a special comb is used to enhance the massage and provide deeper tension relief. This soothing combination helps improve scalp health, ease headaches, promote relaxation, and leave you feeling refreshed, balanced, and uplifted.

services.name: Head Scalp Detoxification with Mini Facial
services.description: The Head Scalp Detoxification with Mini Facial is a restorative treatment designed to cleanse, refresh, and deeply rejuvenate both the scalp and skin. It includes a soothing scalp massage, scalp gua sha, shampoo cleanse, waterfall rinse, conditioning treatment, and a relaxing neck and shoulder massage, enhanced by a spa steamer and eye mask for total relaxation. The mini facial features a gentle cleanse, exfoliation, facial massage, and a hydrating hydro mask. This service helps detoxify the scalp, improve circulation, relieve tension, encourage healthier hair growth, hydrate the skin, and leave you feeling completely renewed and refreshed.

services.name: Head Scalp Detoxification
services.description: The Head Scalp Detoxification treatment is a deeply refreshing experience designed to cleanse, soothe, and rejuvenate the scalp while promoting full-body relaxation. This service includes a calming scalp massage, scalp gua sha, shampoo cleanse, waterfall rinse, and nourishing hair conditioner, followed by a relaxing neck and shoulder massage. A spa steamer and eye mask enhance the experience, helping to open pores, boost circulation, and melt away tension. Together, these steps detoxify the scalp, encourage healthier hair growth, relieve stress, and leave you feeling renewed and revitalized.

categories.title: Waxing
intro: Experience smooth, glowing skin with our professional waxing services at Glamour Day Spa. Our expertly trained estheticians use high-quality wax to provide gentle, effective hair removal for both men and women. Whether you're looking to remove unwanted hair from your legs, arms, bikini area, or face, our waxing treatments ensure a comfortable experience with long-lasting results. We prioritize your comfort and skin health, using soothing products to minimize irritation and leave your skin feeling soft and refreshed. Let us help you achieve a flawless finish and a confident glow.

categories.title: Permanent Makeup
intro: Enhance your natural beauty with Glamour Day Spa’s expert permanent makeup services. Whether you desire beautifully defined brows, subtly shaded lips, or perfectly lined eyes, our skilled technicians provide personalized treatments designed to complement your features. Using high-quality pigments and advanced techniques, we create long-lasting results that highlight your unique beauty with precision and elegance. Say goodbye to daily makeup routines and hello to effortless confidence. Our gentle, hygienic procedures ensure both comfort and safety, leaving you with flawless, natural-looking enhancements that last. Discover the art of timeless beauty at Glamour Day Spa.

services.name: Ombre Powder Brows
services.description: Ombre powder brows are a semi-permanent cosmetic tattoo technique that uses a digital machine to create a soft, shaded, powder-makeup effect. The pigment is applied in a gradient—lighter at the front of the brows and gradually deepening toward the tail—to achieve a natural yet defined finish. The result is a fuller, more polished brow look that typically lasts between 1 to 3 years.

services.name: Ombre Powder Brow Refill
services.description: An ombre powder brow refill is a maintenance session designed to refresh and enhance your existing ombre brows. During this appointment, pigment is added to areas that may have faded over time, restoring the soft gradient effect and overall definition. This touch-up helps maintain the color, shape, and polished, powder-like finish of your brows for long-lasting, flawless results.

services.name: Lip Blush Permament
services.description: Lip blush is a semi-permanent makeup treatment that enhances the lips by depositing pigment to create a soft, natural wash of color. The process begins with a consultation to select the ideal shade and shape, followed by numbing to ensure comfort. A fine needle is then used to gently implant pigment into the lip surface, resulting in a beautifully tinted, refreshed look.

services.name: Microblading
services.description: Microblading is a semi-permanent eyebrow treatment that uses a handheld tool with a small blade to create precise, hair-like strokes in sparse or thinning areas. By implanting pigment into the skin’s top layer, it delivers a natural, fuller brow appearance that can last 18–30 months. The procedure offers long-lasting, smudge-proof results and eliminates the need for daily brow makeup, enhancing your overall look with ease.

services.name: Eyeliner
services.description: Permanent eyeliner, also called an eyeliner tattoo, involves implanting pigment along the lash line to create a long-lasting makeup effect that typically lasts 1–3 years. This cosmetic tattoo procedure can be tailored to your style—whether you prefer a subtle lash enhancement, a defined line, or a bold winged look. The process is generally comfortable and delivers a polished, effortless appearance every day.

categories.title: Couple Packages
intro: Share a moment of bliss with our luxurious couples packages at Glamour Day Spa. Crafted for ultimate relaxation and connection, these experiences include side-by-side massages, revitalizing facials, and calming therapies. Perfect for special occasions or simply quality time together, our couples packages offer a serene, private escape. Leave feeling rejuvenated, refreshed, and more connected than ever.

services.name: Couples Massage
services.description: Indulge in the ultimate romantic escape with our signature couples massage, designed to help you unwind and reconnect on a deeper level. Enjoy synchronized, soothing strokes that melt away tension, improve circulation, and rejuvenate your entire body. Relax side-by-side in a private, tranquil room with two dedicated therapists creating a shared experience of calm, comfort, and togetherness—perfect for celebrating love, relieving stress, or simply enjoying quality time.

services.name: Couples Signature Facials
services.description: Experience a revitalizing facial that deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and purifies the skin, followed by gentle steaming, precise extractions, and a nourishing hydrating mask. This treatment is complemented by a soothing face, head, neck, and shoulder massage, delivering total relaxation while leaving your skin refreshed, balanced, and glowing.

services.name: Couples Hot Stone Massage
services.description: Celebrate love with our exclusive spa experience designed for pure indulgence. Begin with a deeply therapeutic 60-minute deep tissue massage enhanced with warm, soothing hot stones to melt away tension. Then, unwind in a private luxury suite with 30 minutes of serene relaxation, complete with chilled champagne and decadent chocolates—the perfect way to connect, celebrate, and escape together.
